app.title: AccessLab
app.description: A browser-based accessibility laboratory for developers. Tune UI components in real time and surface WCAG 2.2 violations instantly.

comingSoon.title: {name} is coming soon
comingSoon.body: We're still building support for this component. In the meantime, pick another component from the sidebar to start auditing. Button is ready to go.

errorPage.componentMissing: Component "{slug}" is not in the registry.
errorPage.body1: You have arrived at a destination that doesn't exist. We would explain how you got here, but the link you clicked lacked any meaningful semantic context.
errorPage.body2: We are blaming the developer. It is the safest option.

mobileBlocker.title: AccessLab requires a larger screen
mobileBlocker.p1: AccessLab displays your code, a live preview, and accessibility feedback side-by-side so you can see the immediate impact of your changes. A larger screen is required to display this.
mobileBlocker.footer: Please reopen AccessLab on a laptop or desktop display (1024 pixels wide or more).

issues.whyItMatters: Why it matters & how to fix
issues.nextSteps: Review the WCAG criterion for this rule. Check the affected element in your HTML and apply the recommended fix. Re-run the audit to verify the issue is resolved.
issues.learnMoreInApp: Read more in the Learn tab

home.instruction: Select a component from the sidebar to begin auditing.

manual.title: Manual Review
manual.preface: Automated tools like this one can't catch all accessibility barriers. This manual checklist guides you through the remaining, context-dependent checks that require human judgment.
manual.empty: No manual review items. Axe may flag items as needing human review when it cannot fully determine compliance automatically.

toasts.submitNoForm: This button has no form to submit to. Wrap it in a form element to see the submission captured.
toasts.resetNoForm: This button has no form to reset. Wrap it in a form element to see the reset captured.
toasts.submitNoFormLink: Why is the button attempting to submit a form?
toasts.formSubmittedLink: Why did the button send a form submission?
